_comment: SIC code -> FMP sector label, derived from the symbols carrying both (data/sec/registrants.json x data/static-profile.json). A code maps only with >= 3 known members and >= 70% agreement (basis code), else its 2-digit major group under the same share with >= 5 members (basis major-group); otherwise sector is null (unclassified, reported). Regenerate with node scripts/build-sic-sector.mjs.
